title: Press folders
slide_intent: Help a designer decide what a folder should communicate when someone holds it and what the recipient should discover on opening it.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can gain visibility from a large program mark in a press photograph, or use athlete photography to introduce the program through a personal story.
demonstration: Two rows pair a closed folder with its open interior. The first uses red graphics and a large mark. The second uses a portrait on the cover and a grid of photographs inside.
practical_value: Choose the two-color graphic version for a prominent identifier, or use the photo version when suitable program images and captions are available.

content_islands.name: Comparison key
content_islands.spec: Explain the four numbered views in the left margin and label the two-color and full-color approaches beside their respective rows.

content_islands.name: Graphic folder
content_islands.spec: Pair the red cover with an open view containing an introduction on the left and a document pocket on the right.

content_islands.name: Photographic folder
content_islands.spec: Repeat the arrangement below with a single cover photograph. Place a collage on the interior panel beside the document pocket.
